verdict.rationale: No evidence of a documented public REST/GraphQL API mirroring UI capabilities; explicit probes for OpenAPI/swagger docs all returned 404s. The only programmatic surface found is a gated MCP endpoint (auth-required, scopes read/write/mcp) tied to the AI Assistant chat feature, with no documentation showing it covers the full breadth of UI functionality (Focus Time, Habits, Buffer Time, Calendar Sync, Scheduling Links, etc.).
